It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University, 
Ludhiana—a premier institution dedicated to excellence in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Dairy T echnology 
and Fisheries Education. Rooted in a rich legacy of excellence and guided by a forward-looking vision, our university is 
committed to nurturing competent, ethical, and socially responsive professionals who will shape the future of the animal 
husbandry dairy and fishery sector at national and global levels. As you begin this academic journey with us, you become 
part of an institution that has consistently contributed to transformative advancements in animal health and production.  
Our accomplished faculty, eminent academicians, researchers and mentors deliver an education that goes beyond 
conventional learning. By integrating strong theoretical foundations with hands-on training, we ensure that our graduates 
are not only academically competent but also professionally confident and industry-ready. With state-of-the-art laboratories, 
modern research infrastructure and robust digital resources, the university fosters an ecosystem where inquiry, creativity 
and innovation thrive. Our focus on need-based and translational research enables us to address real-world challenges 
while contributing meaningfully to scientific advancement. 
Education at our university extends well beyond classrooms and laboratories. A vibrant campus life, cultural diversity 
and opportunities for leadership and community engagement help in shaping all rounded individuals. We believe that 
true education nurtures character, values and social responsibility alongside academic growth.
The university offers a comprehensive range of undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across Veterinary 
Sciences, Dairy and Food technology, Fisheries and Animal Biotechnology. 
What truly distinguishes our institution is its unwavering commitment to ethical practices, societal relevance and 
nation-building. We strive to prepare our students not merely for successful careers, but for purpose-driven lives, where 
their knowledge and skills contribute to animal welfare, food security, public health and sustainable rural prosperity. 
For the academic session 2026-27, we look forward to welcoming bright, motivated and talented students from across 
the country who aspire to excel in a rigorous yet nurturing academic environment. 
Join us in our mission to uplift animal husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries sector, strengthen rural livelihoods and contribute 
meaningfully to India’s socio-economic development. 
T ogether, let us build a future where scientific excellence is guided by compassion and service.
Best wishes for a bright future,
Vice-Chancellor
Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University
Ludhiana (Punjab)

College of Fisheries (COF), one of the constituent 
colleges of Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal 
Sciences University, was established in April, 2008, 
to produce professionally competent human resource 
(graduates and postgraduates) to serve the fisheries sector in 
different capacities (teaching, research, extension, planning 
and livelihood generation) for holistic development 
through productivity enhancement and socio-economic 
sustainability. Since its establishment, the College has 
registered a commendable academic growth and has made 
significant R&D contributions for the development of the 
inland fisheries sector in the north-western region of India. 
With five departments, competent experienced faculty, 
smart classrooms, fully equipped modern laboratories and a 
well-developed “Instructional cum Research Farm” (spread 
over an area of 6 ha), COF , Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and 
Animal Sciences University possesses hi-tech facilities for 
effectual teaching, capacity building (experiential learning, 
skill development, trainings and demonstrations), advanced 
research and extension programs.
Fisheries college is accredited by the ICAR with 
“A” grade for 5 years from 2023-2028 and is offering 
undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) degree 
programmes i.e., Master in Fisheries Science (M.F .Sc) and 
Doctorate of Philosophy in different disciplines of fisheries.

During the last three decades, molecular biology 
and biotechnology have emerged with extensive 
applications in animal husbandry, medicine, industry and 
environmental sciences. Recognizing the immense potential

Veterinary and Animal Sciences University established the 
Department of Animal Biotechnology in 2008.

biotechnology and to develop specialized facilities for 
research in cutting-edge fields of biotechnology. The 
college is also involved in basic and applied research 
spanning a wide-spectrum of areas like genomics, molecular 
diagnostics, vaccinology, stem cell biology, cancer biology, 
proteomics, and bioinformatics.

teaching and research, three departments viz., Animal 
Biotechnology, Microbial & Environmental Biotechnology 
and Bioinformatics have been created with excellent 
infrastructure and laboratory facilities. For the UG and PG 
teaching, the college is following the course curriculum as 
recommended by the ICAR.

Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)- 6th 
Deans’ Committee Recommendations, with provision 
of “Multiple Exit and Multiple Entry (MEME)” as per 
National Educational  Policy-2020 (NEP-2020) guidelines 
for higher educational institutes (HEIs). The B.T ech. 
(Biotechnology) degree programme will constitute of eight
